context.content_translation:
伦理委员会在引用该研究项目的潜在益处的同时，也承认了其高昂的成本。
A. 承认
B. 去承认
C. 已承认
D. 承认

items.question: The ethics committee cited the potential benefits of the research project while ------- its high cost.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“acknowledging”代入题干后为“The ethics committee cited the potential benefits of the research project while acknowledging its high cost.”。选择理由：该项的词性或动词形态符合句法位置，同时与上下文语义搭配自然。正确答案：A（acknowledging）。
